comments: Practical calibration infrastructure development; results confirm suitability for detector/dosimeter calibration but represent incremental instrumentation work.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Isfahan MNSR provides suitable neutron field for detector calibration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via experimental measurements and computational validation

title: Inference limits in partially observable Ethereum blockchains
task: Inference limits and observability mechanisms in partially observable Ethereum blockchains
key_results: Partial observability increases RMSE and variance in block-level summaries; MNAR-like missingness causes largest distortion; trend estimation bias grows with increased missingness
comments: First rigorous inferential framework for blockchain observability; reveals that partial data access significantly impacts empirical blockchain analysis reliability.

model_io.model: Observable ledger projection with incomplete observation mechanisms

hypotheses.hypothesis: Observability mechanism type (MCAR vs MAR vs MNAR) determines inference degradation in blockchain analysis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MNAR produces severe distortion; experimental validation on Ethereum blocks 18M-18M+1k

title: Bond–electromagnetic origin of superconducting pairing across materials
task: Structure-anchored framework linking bond dynamics to superconducting pairing
key_results: Structural inputs alone reproduce pairing scales across materials; pressure-dependent dome of FeSe captured without spectroscopic input via T_pair(P)=T_0 exp(a_1 P - a_2 P^2)
comments: Elegant unification of structural and electromagnetic contributions to superconductivity, though predictive power for T_c under extreme conditions untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Superconducting pairing originates from dynamic covalent bonds with structural electromagnetic control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across Al, Pb, and FeSe; pressure-induced dome behavior captured without spectroscopic input

title: Unsupervised multivariate analysis of multiple analysis data fusion combining hydrogen distribution and crystallographic orientation image data of vanadium alloy sample
task: Multimodal data fusion analysis of hydrogen diffusion in vanadium alloys
key_results: Unsupervised fusion of hydrogen distribution and crystallographic orientation reveals orientation-dependent diffusion; [111] and [101] grains exhibit higher diffusion than [001]
comments: Novel multimodal analysis approach successfully extracts feature relationships obscured in single-method analyses.

model_io.model: Multimodal image fusion (hydrogen distribution + EBSD orientation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydrogen diffusion behavior depends on crystallographic orientation in vanadium alloys
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via multimodal analysis; [111], [101] favor diffusion over [001]

title: Ab initio study of structural, optoelectronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Cs2KXBr6 (X = Mo, W): HDPs for spintronic and energy applications
task: Structural, optoelectronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of halide double perovskites
key_results: Cs2KMoBr6 exhibits AFM order (µB=0), Cs2KWBr6 exhibits FM (µB=3); spin-dependent band gaps (Mo: 1.7/2.8 eV, W: 1.6/3.3 eV); optical absorption peak 140 cm⁻¹ at 13.5 eV
comments: Comprehensive ab initio characterization identifies promising spintronic candidates; device-level validation required for technological assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different transition metals (Mo vs W) produce distinct magnetic ground states in halide perovskites
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Mo: AFM, W: FM with different spin moments and band gaps

title: Photoexcitation of moiré-trapped interlayer excitons via chiral phonons
task: Phonon-assisted excitation of moiré-trapped interlayer excitons via chiral phonons
key_results: Novel excitation pathway via chiral E″ phonons at 23 meV mediates valley-selective generation of interlayer excitons; narrow spectral spread with defined helicity
comments: Chiral phonon mechanism offers deterministic quantum emitter generation in TMD systems; first-principles support strengthens mechanistic understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chiral E″ in-plane phonons at 23 meV enable valley-selective interlayer exciton excitation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy and first-principles calculations

title: Exploring supersolids of single-microwave shielded molecules via exact and mean-field theories
task: Mean-field and exact-theory exploration of supersolids in single-microwave-shielded molecules
key_results: Extended Gross-Pitaevskii approach benchmarked against QMC; superfluid, supersolid, droplet states captured; anisotropic superfluidity with direction-dependent sound velocities from elliptic shielding
comments: Comprehensive theoretical framework bridging mean-field and exact methods; single-shielding results suggest broader applicability than previously thought.

model_io.model: Bosonic dipolar molecules under single-microwave shielding

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elliptic microwave polarization induces anisotropic superfluidity with tunable roton instabilities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; quasi-1D theory captures roton softening with polarization dependence

title: Half-quantized Hall plateaus in the confined geometry of graphene
task: Half-quantized Hall plateaus in graphene quantum point contacts
key_results: Observation of half-quantized conductance at ν = 5/2 and other unconventional filling factors; identification of two distinct charge-equilibration mechanisms
comments: Non-topological mechanism provides new perspective on fractional quantum Hall physics near metallic phases and device engineering.

model_io.model: Monolayer graphene quantum point contact in magnetic field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Half-quantized plateaus arise from charge equilibration between FQHE edge states and metallic reservoirs via zeroth Landau level
hypotheses.result: Experimentally observed at unconventional filling factors; confirmed as non-topological origin

title: Modulating nonlinear optical responses in 3R-MoS2 Fabry–Pérot microcavities
task: Nonlinear optical response modulation in 3R-MoS2 Fabry-Pérot microcavities
key_results: Harmonic generation modulated by interplay of absorption, FP effects at fundamental and harmonic frequencies; absorption-limited regime dominates higher-order harmonics
comments: Decouples geometric and material contributions across harmonic orders; provides design paradigm for engineering van der Waals photonic architectures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear response determined by synergistic FP effects at fundamental and harmonic frequencies modulated by intrinsic absorption
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; complex modulation for below-bandgap harmonics; absorption-limited regime for above-bandgap

title: Pre-treatment bacterial cell states shape antibiotic-induced transcriptional reprogramming and survival
task: Characterize how pre-treatment transcriptional states determine antibiotic survival through single-cell heterogeneity
key_results: Distinct transcriptional responses shaped by growth phase and pre-treatment state co-contribute to survival; rpoS deletion and nutrient supplementation shift cell states and alter survival frequencies
comments: Demonstrates that phenotypic heterogeneity is mechanistically linked to pre-treatment conditions rather than purely stochastic, opening avenues for state-based intervention strategies.

model_io.model: Single-cell RNA sequencing in Klebsiella pneumoniae

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-treatment transcriptional state determines antibiotic-induced transcriptional response and survival
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: growth phase and pre-treatment state shape distinct survival-relevant transcriptional programs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modulating pre-treatment cell states can alter survival outcomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: rpoS deletion and nutrient supplementation shift cell states and survival frequencies

title: Programmable, multiplexed and orthogonal gene control in bacteria with attenuated Cas13d systems
task: Engineer attenuated Cas13d systems for multiplexed, orthogonal and reversible bacterial gene regulation
key_results: Protein engineering generated Cas13d variants with 2.2-fold higher growth OD and tunable RNase activity; demonstrated multiplexed gene control and lycopene pathway optimization with improved yields
comments: Addresses critical synthetic biology bottleneck of Cas13 toxicity through rational design; spacer mismatch strategy elegantly enables functional switching between different regulatory modes.

model_io.model: Attenuated Cas13d system with engineered spacers
inputs: CRISPR RNA spacers with proximal mismatches

model_io.model: Lycopene biosynthesis pathway in Escherichia coli

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flexible region truncation reduces Cas13d cytotoxicity while maintaining knockdown
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: attenuated variants show 2.2-fold higher growth OD and effective transcript knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: Proximal spacer mismatches enable functional mode switching
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: system achieves translation inhibition, mRNA degradation, and translation activation switching
